scope: Completed primary generation cells and turns only; every file, no exclusions.
order: Original full relative path order; filenames and file bytes retained.
container: One normalized PAX TAR member in ZIP_LZMA; mode 0644, mtime/uid/gid 0; fixed ZIP date; ZIP64 member on a seekable output.
encoder: Python zipfile ZIP_LZMA default encoder; no numeric preset claimed.

verification.method: Complete ZIP CRC check followed by streaming TAR readback of every member and exact comparison to retained source bytes.

limits: Unredacted private preflight archive, not anonymous or suitable for upload.
Only cells and turns; excludes other generation metadata, native reports, SCC, datasets, sources and scientific documents.
No quality outcome interpretation, scientific replay or final package-size claim.
ZIP LZMA is less universally supported than Deflate; this verifies Python standard-library readback, not every archive application.
Streaming readback verifies recoverable file paths and bytes, but is not the final clean-directory package extraction and replay.
